stories.title: Ukraine - Russie : Trump annonce la fin mutuelle des frappes sur les sites énergétiques

en.title: Ukraine-Russia: Trump announces mutual end to strikes on energy sites
en.summary: Donald Trump stated that Ukraine and Russia have committed to ceasing attacks on each other's energy infrastructure, an announcement made on his Truth Social platform.

stories.title: Guerre au Moyen-Orient : Donald Trump affirme être «ouvert» à la discussion avec l'Iran

en.title: Middle East conflict: Donald Trump says he is "open" to discussions with Iran
en.summary: The U.S. president expressed openness to dialogue with Iran regarding Middle East hostilities, following earlier predictions that conflict would end after U.S. legislative elections in November.

stories.title: Ukraine : pourquoi la Russie pousse la guerre toujours plus près des frontières avec l’Europe

en.title: Ukraine: why Russia is pushing the war increasingly closer to Europe's borders
en.summary: Russian drone strikes near the Ukraine-Poland border have intensified, with multiple incidents targeting border posts and crossing points between Ukraine and European countries.

stories.title: Municipales : l’annulation de deux victoires insoumises près de Lyon préconisée devant le tribunal administratif

en.title: Municipal elections: cancellation of two far-left victories near Lyon recommended to administrative court
en.summary: A public official recommended to the administrative court the annulment of municipal election results in Vénissieux and Vaulx-en-Velin due to irregularities on other candidate lists.

stories.title: EN DIRECT, guerre en Ukraine : Donald Trump affirme que Kiev et Moscou ont accepté de cesser les bombardements sur les infrastructures énergétiques

en.title: LIVE: War in Ukraine - Donald Trump states that Kyiv and Moscow have agreed to cease bombardments on energy infrastructure
en.summary: The US president announced on Truth Social that Ukraine and Russia have agreed to stop targeting energy infrastructure, while he attributed the global diesel price increase to the Ukraine conflict rather than US military operations against Iran.

stories.title: Municipales 2026 : l'annulation de deux victoires de LFI près de Lyon préconisée devant le tribunal administratif, en raison d'irrégularités sur d'autres listes

en.title: 2026 Municipal elections: Cancellation of two LFI victories near Lyon recommended before administrative court due to irregularities on other ballots
en.summary: Administrative courts have been recommended to annul municipal election results in Vénissieux and Vaulx-en-Velin where leftist candidates won, citing irregularities affecting other candidate lists.

stories.title: Municipales : vers l’annulation de deux victoires LFI en banlieue lyonnaise à cause d’irrégularités sur d’autres listes ?

en.title: Municipal elections: Towards cancellation of two LFI victories in Lyon suburbs due to irregularities on other ballots
en.summary: Lyon's administrative court rapporteur has recommended annulling municipal elections in Vaulx-en-Velin and Vénissieux where two leftist mayors were narrowly elected.

stories.title: Guerre en Ukraine : la frappe contre un train démontre "la fébrilité de Vladimir Poutine dans un moment où la Russie va très mal", estime le chef de la diplomatie française

en.title: War in Ukraine: Strike against a train demonstrates "Vladimir Putin's nervousness at a time when Russia is faring very poorly," according to French foreign affairs chief
en.summary: France's foreign minister stated that recent Russian attacks on Ukraine aim to intimidate Europeans and reflect instability in Russia's position.

stories.title: Guerre en Ukraine : le Kremlin estime que les frappes russes près de la frontière polonaise étaient justifiées

en.title: Ukraine War: Kremlin says Russian strikes near Polish border were justified
en.summary: A Russian drone struck a passenger train traveling between Kyiv and Warsaw, 2 kilometers from Poland's border, on Sunday without causing casualties. The Kremlin defended the strikes as justified.

stories.title: Ce que l'on sait de la frappe de drone russe contre un train en Ukraine près de la frontière avec la Pologne

en.title: What we know about the Russian drone strike on a train in Ukraine near the Polish border
en.summary: Ukrainian railway authorities suggest a Russian drone attack may have targeted a train carrying European security advisors and former leaders, including former British Prime Minister Boris Johnson.

stories.title: Jean-Luc Mélenchon dénonce des « manipulations politiques » après la demande d’annulation de deux victoires de LFI aux municipales

en.title: Jean-Luc Mélenchon denounces 'political manipulation' after request to annul two La France Insoumise victories in municipal elections
en.summary: Two candidates from the La France Insoumise party won municipal elections in March 2024, defeating socialist and communist incumbents in their respective cities. Mélenchon characterized the annulation request as political manipulation.

stories.title: Guerre en Ukraine : Poutine veut «désunir» l’Europe, accusent plusieurs ministres européens après la frappe «inacceptable» contre un train

en.title: Ukraine War: Putin wants to 'divide' Europe, several European ministers accuse after 'unacceptable' strike against train
en.summary: Several European ministers condemned Russian strikes in Ukraine over the weekend, including one targeting a train near the Polish border, claiming the action aims to divide Europe.

stories.title: Spatial : ArcSpace s'installe à Toulouse pour sa soudeuse qui répare les satellites en orbite

en.title: Space: ArcSpace establishes itself in Toulouse for its welder that repairs satellites in orbit
en.summary: ArcSpace, developing a welding device weighing under 2 kilograms designed to repair satellites in space, is establishing operations in Toulouse to accelerate the deployment of in-orbit services.

stories.title: Gaz : À 1 000 mètres sous terre, la course au remplissage des réserves françaises

en.title: Gas: 1,000 meters underground, the race to fill French reserves
en.summary: France's risk of gas shortage by year-end is diminishing as storage facilities fill up. The Chémery facility in Loir-et-Cher has already reached 80% capacity, demonstrating the infrastructure supporting France's gas supply security.

stories.title: Sentinel 3C et FLEX : deux satellites européens pour mieux comprendre le dérèglement climatique

en.title: Sentinel 3C and FLEX: two European satellites to better understand climate disruption
en.summary: Two Earth observation satellites are scheduled for launch on a Vega C rocket in mid-September for Eumetsat and the European Space Agency. The missions will provide detailed study of climate patterns and vegetation across the planet.

stories.title: Portrait : Adrien Facon, nouveau directeur de l’Agence de l’innovation de défense

en.title: Portrait: Adrien Facon, new director of the Defense Innovation Agency
en.summary: Adrien Facon has been appointed as the new director of France's defense innovation agency, with quantum technology as a focus area.

stories.title: Retraites, donations, impôt sur le revenu… Ce que l’on sait déjà du budget 2027

en.title: Pensions, donations, income tax… What is already known about the 2027 budget
en.summary: The government is considering measures to reduce the deficit, including asking retirees to contribute more through pension adjustments and tax allowance changes. Plans also include income tax bracket indexation and temporary facilitation of family donations.
